card.name: Digits inside code call parentheses
card.fires_on: A single digit such as 0, 1 or 3 right after an opening parenthesis in programming code or man-page references, e.g. append(1) or binmail(1).

modes.label: Digit argument in code call
modes.description: A small number given as the first argument of a function call in code.

modes.label: Man-page section number
modes.description: The section number in brackets after a command or page name.

card.plain: It fires on a lone digit just inside brackets in code or Unix manual pages, such as a function argument or a man-page section number.
